data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1945 recorded a gross claims reserves opening balance of GBP 167.23m and a gross prior-year run-off release of GBP 23.62m in 2022 (approximately a 14.1% release relative to opening reserves). The release is described as largely driven by favourable development across Accident & Health, Contingency and Property and a reduction in Covid-19 related reserves that did not materialise; this was partly offset by an adverse development in Casualty. The movement is explicitly documented in the Technical Provisions note as a gross positive run-off deviation of GBP 23.6m.
raw_causal_phrases: GBP 11.6m reduction to prior year reserves. Approximately, half of the reduction relates to decreased Covid19 reserves that have not materialised along with favourable experience across the A&H, Contingency and Property classes.

There was a positive runoff deviation in the year of GBP 23.6m made up GBP 17.7m Accident and Health, GBP 8m Contingency, GBP 0.5m Marine and Energy and GBP 13m property which was offset by an adverse deviation of GBP 15.6m in casualty.

During 2021 there was an adverse run off deviation of GBP 31.7m made up of GBP 15.7m Accident and Health, GBP 16.6m Contingency, GBP 3.6m Marine and Energy, GBP 9.6m Property offset by a positive deviation of GBP 13.8m for the Casualty class of business.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior-year movement taken from the Balance Sheet (Technical Provisions) and the Technical Provisions movement table respectively (both gross figures). The report references 'Contingency' which is not a standard Lloyd's LOB; where class names do not map exactly to the standard LOB list they were left in gross_premium_mix as printed. The LOB-level 'Marine and Energy' movement is presented combined in the note (GBP 0.5m) and could not be reliably split between 'Marine' and 'Energy' - amounts for those individual LOBs are therefore set to null with reduced confidence. The claims development triangle is present and was extracted from the gross table (values are shown in GBP 000 in the report and converted to millions here).
